item.title: 用于材料性质预测的共享递归卷积晶体图神经网络 SR-CGCNN
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Satadeep Bhattacharjee
晶体图神经网络通过在局域原子环境中传播信息来预测材料性质，传统 CGCNN 通常通过堆叠彼此独立参数化的卷积层增加传播深度。作者提出共享递归 CGCNN（SR-CGCNN），将主要卷积权重在多次消息传递步中共享，以检验重复应用同一局域更新是否能接近更深网络的效果。基于 Materials Project 数据集的形成能和带隙任务，三步 SR-CGCNN 的精度接近标准三层 CGCNN，但可训练卷积参数仅为后者的 34.5%，显示出显著的参数效率。

We examine whether this coherent operation produces anything that classical post-processing of samples from the unfiltered model cannot match. item.title: Machine learning prediction of organic compound melting points informed by condensed-phase and electronic descriptors
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
Melting point (MP) is an important thermophysical property for the chemical process industry, yet accurate prediction of MP for organic compounds in the absence of experimental data remains challenging due to the complex interplay between molecular packing, intermolecular interactions, and electronic structure. Traditional group contribution and quantitative structure–property relationship models, which rely primarily on static molecular descriptors, often fail to capture these critical condensed-phase effects. In this study, we present a hybrid machine learning framework that integrates cheminformatics descriptors with quantum chemical features and dynamic condensed-phase descriptors derived from molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Using a curated subset of the DIPPR 801 database, multi…

item.title: ArGEnT：用于算子学习的任意几何编码 Transformer
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Wenqian Chen, Zhi-Feng Wei, Yucheng Fu, Michael Penwarden, Pratanu Roy, Panos Stinis

item.title: 通过 Kronecker 预条件优化实现多物理 PINN 的耦合鲁棒精度
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Youngjae Park, Jaemin Kim, Junghwa Hong
本文研究多物理物理信息神经网络在强耦合条件下精度系统性下降的原因，并提出一种原则性的优化修正方法。基于神经切线核分析，作者证明标准核的谱半径会随耦合强度按 Ω(γ²) 增长，而块对角高斯牛顿预条件能够将其上界控制在与耦合无关的网络数 S；任何纯对角预条件都无法恢复这一性质。论文将该思路通过 Kronecker 预条件优化器 SOAP 结合 inverse-gradient-norm 风格的损失平衡来实现，并在多个基准上的大量实验中验证了其对耦合强度的鲁棒性。

arXiv:2608.14477v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent discoveries of two-dimensional (2D) ferromagnets have stimulated intense interest in understanding and controlling their spin transport properties. item.title: Strain flips Hall signal in altermagnetic manganese telluride, suggesting a path to practical spintronics
item.description:
📚 Physics News
Time-reversal symmetry is an exotic behavior found in systems whose internal physics looks different when running forward versus backward in time. For some time, physicists have searched for this behavior in systems with almost no overall magnetization. Such phases are highly prized for spintronics, where information is carried using the quantum spins of electrons.

item.title: Neural spectral element methods for stiff multiphysics PDEs with electrochemical transport benchmarks
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Conrard Giresse Tetsassi Feugmo and David Pankaczy
Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are limited by three interlocking bottlenecks, the PINN trilemma: Monte-Carlo collocation, serial automatic differentiation, and a resulting stochastic loss landscape that prevents quasi-Newton optimisation. These bottlenecks place an empirical accuracy floor on stiff multiphysics problems such as electrochemical transport, well above the sub-percent precision required for quantitative parameter inference. In this paper we address that accuracy floor by replacing the random-collocation pipeline with a spectral one. We introduce the neural spectral element method (NSEM), which evaluates each network only at fixed Legendre–Gauss–Lobatto quadrature nodes and replaces all derivative calls with precomputed spectral differentiation matrices.
